title: Project skeleton, packages and CI
issue: Create the repo skeleton per docs/PLAN.md sections 2, 3 and 7. (1) project.yml for XcodeGen: iOS 17, app target App/ (bundle id com.parsling.ios, dev variant .dev), a tab shell with five empty tabs Learn, Library, Review, Leagues, Profile. (2) Packages QModel, QDomain, QNetwork, QData, QGrader, QDesign, QKeyboard, QFeatures per the dependency arrows in the plan, each with a Package.swift and one trivial passing test. (3) .github/workflows/ci.yml with jobs packages (matrix swift test), app (xcodegen + xcodebuild build and test on a pinned simulator) and snapshots (swift-snapshot-testing of the empty shell, PNGs uploaded as artifacts); pin the macOS image and Xcode version in one place; concurrency group cancels superseded runs. (4) .gitignore (xcodeproj, .build, DerivedData). QDesign: color and spacing tokens ported from Android core/designsystem (read only its Color/Theme/Spacing files). No feature logic yet.
acceptance: CI green (swift test per package, xcodebuild test)
